evals.prompt: Delegate a focused test investigation in parallel and let me watch it.
expected_behavior: Checks tmux and discovers an available delegate CLI before launch.
Creates a named tmux session, announces its attach command, and does not use a hidden delegate background mode.
Builds a scoped prompt with acceptance criteria and supervisor-run verification gates.
Monitors the pane, independently runs the gates after completion, and closes the session.
Runs the simple local inspection directly instead of launching a delegate.
